papers.title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 SAST 度量 LLM 编码智能体中间轨迹上的安全债，对象是 SWE-bench 生成代码。
papers.abstract: 大模型编码智能体在提交最终方案前，往往会经过成百上千个中间代码状态。只评估最终产物，就无法衡量安全发现沿轨迹如何演化。作者提出安全债线积分（SDLI）：当智能体达到新的最佳测试通过率时，把静态分析风险累加进去。他们用四种静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具实例化该方法，并研究 830 次通过的 SWE-bench 运行、712 个 ProgramBench 最终工作区，以及 13 条公开 MirrorCode 轨迹。两个大规模样本使用的是 SDLI 的终态特例。两款工具在 CWE 类别上的一致率，在 SWE-bench 中为 3.9%，在至少通过 90% 官方测试的 80 次 ProgramBench 运行中为 26.2%。这些只是扫描器发现，并非经验证的漏洞率。排除三类偏咨询性的类别后，后者降至 6.2%。同一任务的多次运行测分不同；一次重建的 ProgramBench 运行从首次实现写入起就持续带有发现。修复案例研究能在保持被测行为的同时降低扫描信号，但也暴露出对等价 API 改写的敏感性。SDLI 提供了同时观察进度与安全发现的方式；其用于引导智能体、确认可利用漏洞的价值仍有待验证。
papers.abstractEn: LLM coding agents can traverse hundreds of intermediate code states before submitting a solution. Evaluating only the final artifact leaves the evolution of security findings unmeasured. We introduce the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which accumulates static-analysis risk when an agent reaches a new best test pass ratio. We instantiate it with four static application security testing (SAST) tools and study artifacts from 830 passing SWE-bench runs, 712 ProgramBench final workspaces, and 13 public MirrorCode trajectories. The two large populations use the final-state special case of SDLI. Two-tool Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class agreement occurs in 3.9% of SWE-bench runs and 26.2% of the 80 ProgramBench runs passing at least 90% of official tests. These are scanner findings, not validated vulnerability rates. Excluding three advisory-heavy classes reduces the latter rate to 6.2%. Same-task runs differ in their measured scores, while one reconstructed ProgramBench run exposes persistent findings from its first implementation write. A repair case study reduces the scanner signal while preserving tested behavior, but also reveals sensitivity to equivalent API rewrites. SDLI offers a way to study progress and security findings together. Its value for steering agents and confirming exploitable vulnerabilities remains to be established.

papers.title: ReproBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Reproducing Vulnerability From Scratch
papers.abstractOneWord: 评测 LLM 智能体能否仅凭 CVE 从零复现漏洞，对象是 IoT 固件。
papers.abstract: 大模型智能体正越来越多地被放在漏洞复现、利用与修补等网络安全任务上评测。但现有基准大多采用“事后环境”设定：直接把源代码、容器或可执行二进制交给智能体，从而跳过了关键的环境重建步骤，也留下一个面向真实漏洞分析的基本问题：智能体能否完全从零自主重建执行环境并复现漏洞？为此，作者提出证据锚定基准 ReproBench，评估智能体仅凭 CVE 标识符完成端到端漏洞复现的能力。ReproBench 把完整复现流程拆成六个阶段，并用可核验实验产物（下载的固件镜像、解包二进制、细粒度分析日志、经验证的崩溃样本等）分别打分。基准实例化为 30 个真实 IoT 固件漏洞。评估显示，45.3% 的测试运行会退回到漏洞模拟——这是所有被测 LLM 智能体都采用的常见补救捷径——而只有 5.3% 的 CVE–模型对成功复现了真实漏洞。尽管总体成功率很低，这些非平凡成功案例表明，前沿 LLM 智能体已具备完全自主的端到端漏洞复现能力。对失败案例的深入分析则指出了复现流水线中的核心瓶颈，为后续研究提供了可操作线索。
papers.abstractEn: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly evaluated on cybersecurity tasks such as vulnerability reproduction, exploitation, and patching. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks predominantly operate under a post-environment evaluation paradigm, i.e., handing the agent source code, a container, or an executable binary. This setup bypasses the critical environment reconstruction step, leaving a fundamental question for real-world vulnerability analysis: can an agent autonomously reconstruct the required execution environment and reproduce a vulnerability entirely from scratch? To address this gap, we present ReproBench, an evidence-grounded benchmark designed to evaluate agent capabilities in end-to-end vulnerability reproduction starting from solely a CVE identifier. ReproBench decomposes the full reproduction workflow into six distinct phases, and assesses performance on each phase independently using verifiable experimental artifacts: downloaded firmware images, unpacked binaries, granular analysis logs, and validated crash samples, among others. We instantiate ReproBench with 30 real-world IoT firmware vulnerabilities, which serve as ideal test cases for our from-scratch evaluation setting. Our evaluation demonstrates that 45.3% of test runs resort to vulnerability simulation - a prevalent remediation workaround adopted across all evaluated LLM agents - while only 5.3% of CVE-model pairs achieve successful reproduction of real-world vulnerabilities. Despite the low overall success rate, these non-trivial successful cases confirm that state-of-the-art LLM agents already possess the capacity for fully autonomous end-to-end vulnerability reproduction. Concurrently, our in-depth analysis of failed cases identifies core bottlenecks impeding LLM agents throughout the reproduction pipeline, offering actionable insights for subsequent research.

papers.title: Continuous Assurance of Agentic Security Auditors for Software Delivery Decision Gates
papers.abstractOneWord: 为 CI 中的 LLM 仓库审计器提供持续保证与合并门控，对象是 Python 代码审计流水线。
papers.abstract: 基于大模型的仓库审计器正越来越多地作为安全控制部署在持续集成（CI）流水线中，其发现会放行、阻断或推迟软件变更。作为智能体化软件开发生命周期（SDLC）安全控制，它们的非确定性会改变证据本身，而组织风险偏好以及司法辖区或数据主权政策又会改变对证据的解释。因此，一次性审计无法为合并决策维持当前保证。作者提出策略–证据–执行分离模式，由可信 AI 态势（TAIP）保证引擎实现，并以持续控制态势保证（CCPA）方式运行。通过把策略与稳定执行分离，并把被接纳证据绑定到版本化的态势树，同一套保证逻辑可跨模型、环境和策略配置工作。评估使用未经修改的 RepoAudit，在固定的 Python 空指针解引用基准上完成。保留的证据库包含 80 次 RepoAudit 执行，覆盖 gpt-4o-mini 与 gpt-4.1 两种 OpenAI 模型配置。TAIP 在策略、证据和模型上下文变化后重新计算保证态势，并在数量递增的独立决策网关上下文中评估。一次执行中三次策略类周期的策略到态势延迟最大为 1.1 ms。在 1000 个独立保证上下文、单 worker 全量策略触发重算时，最大合计刷新时间为 1.62 秒，低于预先声明的 5 秒决策网关预算。这些单机测量针对保留证据上的保证，不包括 RepoAudit 执行和模型推理。
papers.abstractEn: Large language model (LLM)-based repository auditors are increasingly deployed as security controls within continuous integration (CI) pipelines, where their findings admit, block, or delay software changes. As Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Security Controls, their non-deterministic behaviour changes the evidence, while organisational risk appetite and jurisdictional or data-sovereignty policy change its interpretation. Point-in-time audits therefore cannot maintain current assurance for merge decisions. We propose the Policy-Evidence-Execution Separation Pattern, implemented by the Trustworthy AI Posture (TAIP) Assurance Engine and operated as Continuous Control Posture Assurance (CCPA). By separating policy from stable execution and binding admitted evidence to a versioned Posture Tree, the same assurance logic operates across models, environments, and policy profiles. We evaluate the approach using unmodified RepoAudit on a fixed Python Null Pointer Dereference benchmark. The retained evidence repository contains 80 RepoAudit executions across two OpenAI model configurations, gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1. TAIP recomputes assurance posture after policy, evidence, and model-context changes and is evaluated across increasing numbers of independent Decision Gateway contexts. The maximum observed policy-to-posture latency was 1.1 ms across three policy-class cycles in one execution. At 1,000 independent assurance contexts, full policy-triggered recomputation with one worker recorded a maximum aggregate refresh of 1.62 s, below the predeclared 5 s Decision Gateway budget. These single-host measurements concern assurance over retained evidence and exclude RepoAudit execution and provider inference.

papers.title: HESP: Separating What to Probe from When to Stop in Local LLM Alert-Triage Agents
papers.abstractOneWord: 把告警研判的探测与停止从本地 LLM 中拆出，对象是 SOC 告警分诊。
papers.abstract: 安全运营中心收到的告警远超分析师可调查的数量；无法把遥测送往托管模型的组织，只能用自有硬件上的小规模开源权重大模型做自动分诊。现有 LLM 智能体把调查流程交给模型本身，而小型本地模型会失败：它们探测却不收敛、从不给出裁决，或把真实攻击打发掉。本文提出 HESP，一个把调查流程放在模型之外的控制器。HESP 维护相互竞争解释的账本，按单位成本期望信息增益选择只读探测，只接受有当前证据支撑的裁决，可自行结束调查，并在观察前把每次预测记入日志。作者用两个家族、5 个开源权重模型（7B 到 72B）做了四项预注册研究，在受控分诊环境中共 7272 次可审计回合。用无 LLM 运行统计得到的似然表时，HESP 把 Qwen2.5-7B 的已验证完成率从 0.125 提到 1.000，与 oracle 表相当。信息增益排序给每个能给出结论的模型带来 +0.26 到 +0.35；控制器侧停止则让原本从不自行收场的 Llama-3.1-8B 从 0 升到 0.917。因此“探测什么”和“何时停止”是两类不同失败，不同小模型表现也不同。HESP 及其规划器完全在本地硬件运行，适合遥测不得离境的环境。代码、协议与回合日志已发布。
papers.abstractEn: Security operations centers receive far more alerts than analysts can investigate, and organizations that cannot send their telemetry to hosted models must automate triage with small open-weight LLMs on their own hardware. Current LLM agents leave the investigation procedure to the model, and small local models fail at it: they probe without converging, never commit to a verdict, or dismiss real attacks. In this paper, we present HESP, a controller that holds the investigation procedure outside the model. HESP keeps a ledger of competing explanations, selects read-only probes by expected information gain per cost, accepts only verdicts backed by current evidence, can end an investigation itself, and journals every prediction before its observation. We evaluated HESP in four pre-registered studies with five open-weight models from two families (7B to 72B), totalling 7,272 audited episodes in a controlled triage environment. With likelihood tables counted from LLM-free runs, HESP lifts Qwen2.5-7B from 0.125 to 1.000 verified completion, matching oracle tables. The information-gain ranking adds +0.26 to +0.35 on every model that concludes, and a controller-side stop lifts Llama-3.1-8B, which never concludes on its own, from 0 to 0.917. What to probe and when to stop are therefore separate failures, and different small models exhibit different ones. Because HESP and its planner run entirely on local hardware, it suits environments where telemetry cannot leave the premises. We release all code, protocols, and episode journals at https://github.com/lzwhehe/HESP.

papers.title: CyberClear: A Benchmark for LLM Agent Systems on APT Attack Chain Provenance
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM 智能体从长上下文安全日志重建 APT 攻击链，对象是企业安全日志。
papers.abstract: 大模型智能体在网络安全任务上已显示出潜力，但从复杂安全日志中重建完整高级持续性威胁（APT）攻击活动的能力仍基本未被研究。现有面向智能体的网络安全基准主要关注漏洞发现、利用与安全分析，对真实安全日志下攻击链溯源的评测不足。作者提出 CyberClear，用于评估 LLM 智能体及更复杂智能体系统从长上下文安全日志中做 APT 攻击链溯源的能力。基准覆盖单步攻击与多阶段攻击链，要求智能体识别攻击证据、推断攻击进展，并生成包含实体、因果关系、MITRE ATT&CK 技术与取证证据的溯源图。为支持全面评估，作者设计了面向 APT 攻击链溯源的评价方法：不同于关注表层匹配的文本相似度，该方法检查重建图是否在单步行为正确性、多步行为识别、时序与因果一致性、实体与关系保真以及整体攻击叙事一致性上保持攻击链语义。由前沿大模型驱动的先进多智能体系统在 CyberClear 上仍然吃力。作者因此提出面向多智能体的网络取证 harness CyberProvenance，以证据累积、基于执行的校验和反馈引导的精化来增强 LLM 智能体。在 CyberClear 上的广泛评估表明，该方法能改进证据推理、落地执行校验以及完整 APT 攻击链重建。
papers.abstractEn: Large language model agents have demonstrated promising capabilities in cybersecurity tasks, yet their ability to reconstruct complete Advanced Persistent Threat attack campaigns from complex security logs remains largely unexplored. Existing cybersecurity benchmarks for agents mainly focus on vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and security analysis tasks, leaving the evaluation of attack chain provenance under realistic security logs insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce CyberClear, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents and advanced agent systems on APT attack chain provenance from long-context security logs. CyberClear covers both single-step attacks and multi-stage attack chains, requiring agents to identify attack evidence, infer attack progression, and generate provenance graphs containing entities, causal relationships, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and forensic evidence. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we develop an evaluation method tailored to APT attack chain provenance. Unlike conventional text similarity metrics that focus on surface-level matching, our evaluation examines whether reconstructed graphs preserve the semantics of attack chains across single-step behavior correctness, multi-step behavior identification, temporal and causal consistency, entity and relationship fidelity, and overall attack narrative consistency. Advanced multi-agent systems powered by state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle on CyberClear, motivating us to propose CyberProvenance, an agent cyber harness designed for multi-agents that augments LLM agents with evidence accumulation, execution-based validation, and feedback-guided refinement mechanisms for reliable attack-chain provenance. Extensive evaluations on CyberClear demonstrate the effectiveness of CyberProvenance in improving evidence reasoning, execution-grounded validation, and complete APT attack chain reconstruction.

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Automatic Security Proofs for Cryptographic Protocols: How Far Are We?
papers.abstractOneWord: 系统评估 LLM 辅助密码协议符号验证能走多远，对象是密码协议。
papers.abstract: 大模型在软件与安全分析任务上已显示出潜力，但其在密码学符号协议验证中的有效性仍不够清楚。本文对前沿大模型在密码学符号协议验证上的能力做了据称首次系统评估。为量化该能力，作者提出基于证明的指标 CRoST（求解树覆盖率），由验证器的证明骨架导出，衡量生成引理与参考引理的相似度，并经理论分析与经验验证说明其合理性。结果显示，前沿模型平均覆盖率为 38.82%，其中 14.4% 的生成引理覆盖率超过 80%，表明大模型已能在一定程度上生成有用引理。但它们在复杂多相协议上仍有不可忽视的失败模式，朴素扩大规模收益递减，且验证开销很大。这些发现澄清了大模型用于协议验证的实际潜力与局限，并推动后续面向复杂真实协议的工作。
papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for assisting software and security analysis tasks, yet their effectiveness in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic evaluation of the capability of state-of-the-art LLMs in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification. To quantify this capability, we propose CRoST (Coverage Rate of Solve Tree), a proof-based metric derived from the verifier's proof skeleton that measures the similarity between generated lemmas and reference lemmas. We then establish the rationale of CRoST through both theoretical analysis and empirical validation. The evaluation results show that state-of-the-art models achieve 38.82% coverage on average, with 14.4% of generated lemmas exceeding 80% coverage, indicating that LLMs can already generate useful lemmas to a certain extent. However, they still exhibit non-trivial failure modes on complex multi-phase protocols, show diminishing returns under naive scaling, and incur substantial verification overhead. These findings clarify the practical potential and limitations of LLMs for protocol verification and motivate future work on complex real-world protocols.

papers.title: SmartMemory: Detecting On-chain-off-chain Communication Inconsistency for Smart Contract via Memory-based Agent
papers.abstractOneWord: 用记忆型智能体检测智能合约链上链下通信不一致，对象是跨链桥与稳定币等 OFC 合约。
papers.abstract: 智能合约支撑去中心化金融，链上/链下通信（OFC）需求增长，催生了跨链桥、实物资产代币化、法币抵押稳定币等应用。这些应用中与 OFC 相关的安全事件日益频繁，但已有研究多针对 OFC 应用中的单一漏洞类别，缺少统一视角，因而会漏掉已知模式之外的漏洞。本文将 OFC 不一致（OFCI）识别为 OFC 漏洞的根因：它来自业务逻辑缺陷，最终破坏链上与链下资产表示的等价性。自动检测 OFCI 面临两项挑战：定位异构业务逻辑，以及把已有漏洞知识迁移到未见实例。作者提出 SmartMemory，据称首个用记忆型智能体做 OFCI 检测的框架。针对异构性，它把多样的 OFC 合约实现映射为规范的业务语义表示，以便定位待检查的业务逻辑；针对知识复用，记忆型智能体把漏洞特征蒸馏成模式与检测规则，从而跨案例迁移并识别未见 OFCI。随后用污点分析验证每个候选的可达性、类型与影响。作者构建了首个真实 OFCI 数据集（48 个 DApp、81 个 OFCI），SmartMemory 达到 80.68% 精度和 87.65% 召回。对 325 个真实 OFC 应用的分析还发现 36 个此前未知的 OFCI，均已得到对应方确认并修复。
papers.abstractEn: Smart contracts underpin decentralized finance, where growing demand for on-chain/off-chain communication(OFC) has driven diverse applications such as cross-chain bridges, real-world asset tokenization, and fiat-backed stablecoins. The OFC-related security incidents in these applications are increasingly frequent, but prior studies address separate vulnerability categories within OFC applications rather than providing a unified view, causing vulnerabilities outside known patterns to be missed. In this paper, we identify OFC inconsistency (OFCI) as a root cause of OFC vulnerabilities, which arises from business-logic flaw and ultimately breaks the equivalence between the on-chain and off-chain asset representations to induce inconsistency. Automatically detecting OFCIs faces two challenges including (1) locating heterogeneous business logic, and (2) transferring existing vulnerability knowledge to identify unseen OFCI instances. To this end, we propose SmartMemory, the first framework to leverage a memory-based agent for OFCI detection. To address heterogeneity, SmartMemory maps diverse implementations of OFC contracts into a canonical business-semantic representation to locate the business logic for OFCI inspection. For knowledge reuse, SmartMemory integrates a memory-based agent to distill vulnerability knowledge from features into patterns and detection rules, enabling knowledge transfer across cases to identify unseen OFCIs. Lastly, SmartMemory performs taint analysis to verify the reachability, type, and impact of each candidate OFCI. We construct the first real-world OFCI dataset comprising 48 DApps with 81 OFCIs for evaluation, on which SmartMemory achieves 80.68% precision and 87.65% recall. In addition, through an analysis of 325 real-world OFC applications, SmartMemory detects 36 previously unknown OFCIs, all of which have been confirmed and fixed by corresponding parties.

papers.title: Incrementally Verifiable Computation without Extraction
papers.abstractOneWord: 用不依赖抽取的混淆构造全简洁增量可验证计算，无 LLM，对象是证明系统与 IVC。
papers.abstract: 增量可验证计算（IVC）允许迭代证明：配置 x0 经机器 M 的 T 次（可非确定性）重复应用到达配置 xT。若证明大小既不依赖于 T，也不依赖于中间配置的大小，则称该 IVC 方案是全简洁的。本文提出一种基于不可区分混淆（iO）的新 IVC 途径，避开先前构造中以抽取为核心的安全性分析。在 iO 与单向函数的次指数困难假设下，作者为确定性计算构造了自适应可靠的全简洁 IVC，这是首个不依赖代数假设的确定性计算 IVC。在相同假设下，他们进一步得到针对 NP 的全简洁两跳 IVC（非自适应可靠性），可证明 x0 经中间配置 x1 到达 x2；这也是首个对 NP 达到全简洁的 IVC。构造基于 IVC 与图中 s-t 连通秘密分享之间的新联系。
papers.abstractEn: Incrementally verifiable computation (IVC) [Valiant, TCC '08] allows one to iteratively prove that a configuration x_0 reaches a configuration x_T via T repeated applications of a (possibly non-deterministic) machine M. An IVC scheme is fully succinct if the proof size is independent of both T and the size of the intermediate configurations. In this work, we develop a new indistinguishability obfuscation (iO)-based approach to IVC that avoids the extraction-based security analyses central to prior constructions. Assuming subexponential hardness of iO and one-way functions, we construct an adaptively sound fully succinct IVC scheme for deterministic computations. This yields the first IVC for deterministic computations that does not rely on algebraic assumptions. Under the same assumptions, we further obtain a fully succinct two-hop IVC scheme for NP with non-adaptive soundness, allowing one to prove that x_0 reaches x_2 via an intermediate configuration x_1. This is the first IVC scheme for NP achieving full succinctness. Our constructions are based on a new connection between IVC and secret sharing for s-t connectivity in graphs.

papers.title: Compact Shielded CSV: Post-Quantum, Private, Lightweight Client-Side Validation Blockchain
papers.abstractOneWord: 提出抗量子、隐私、轻量的客户端验证区块链以防双花，无 LLM，对象是点对点支付链。
papers.abstract: 作者提出 Compact Shielded CSV，一种面向后量子时代的隐私客户端验证区块链，用于点对点支付。把现有区块链升级到抗量子密码会显著增加链上开销。通过把大型密码学材料全部留在链下，Compact Shielded CSV 使链上占用与底层证明和签名的大小无关。单输入交易的链上占用仅为 3 个哈希（3×32 字节）：空值器、degriefer，以及交易承诺。作者引入 degriefer——一种仅用哈希承诺强制所有权并防止双花的新机制，从而完全不再需要链上签名。这些性质使 Compact Shielded CSV 有望成为隐私、可扩展、抗量子数字支付的基础。
papers.abstractEn: We propose Compact Shielded CSV, a private client-side validation blockchain for peer-to-peer payments designed for the postquantum era. Upgrading existing blockchains to quantum-resistant cryptography substantially increases on-chain overhead. By keeping all large cryptographic artifacts off-chain, Compact Shielded CSV keeps a minimal on-chain footprint independent of the size of the underlying cryptographic proofs and signatures. For a single input transaction, the onchain footprint is just 3 hashes (3x32 bytes): a nullifier, a degriefer, and a commitment to the transaction. We introduce the degriefer - a novel mechanism that enforces ownership and prevents double-spending using only hash commitments, eliminating the need for on-chain signatures entirely. These properties make Compact Shielded CSV a promising foundation for private, scalable, post-quantum digital payments.

papers.title: Simple and Fast Signature-Free Blockchain Consensus
papers.abstractOneWord: 给出无签名、面向后量子的区块链共识协议，无 LLM，对象是区块链共识。
papers.abstract: 无签名协议可以避开后量子签名的开销。作者给出两个面向最终同步的简单无签名区块链共识协议：在 f<n/3 时好情况提交延迟为三次消息延迟，在 f<n/5 时为两次，并具有乐观响应性、无需投机即可达到两次消息延迟的出块时间，以及每视图 O(n^2) 通信。它们实例化 Generic Simplex，这是一种由新抽象“视图协定”参数化的区块链共识构造。同一构造还覆盖 Simplex、Minimmit，以及一个新的同步无签名协议，在 f<n/4 时达到两次消息延迟的最优好情况提交延迟。
papers.abstractEn: Signature-free protocols avoid the cost of post-quantum signatures. We present two simple signature-free blockchain consensus protocols for eventual synchrony with optimal good-case commit latency (three message delays for f<n/3 and two for f<n/5), optimistic responsiveness, a block time of only two message delays without speculation, and O(n^2) communication per view. They instantiate Generic Simplex, a blockchain consensus construction parameterized by a new abstraction called view agreement. The same construction also captures Simplex, Minimmit, and a new synchronous signature-free protocol with optimal good-case commit latency of two message delays for f<n/4.

papers.title: The Cost of Rewinding for Succinct Arguments: Strict-Time Barriers and Expected-Time Security
papers.abstractOneWord: 分析简洁论证中回绕归约的严格时间损失与期望时间安全性，无 LLM，对象是区块链所用 SNARK。
papers.abstract: 简洁论证是核心密码学对象，支撑区块链与图像认证等应用。实践中几乎所有简洁论证都沿用 Kilian（STOC 1992）提出的提交-打开范式：先对概率证明做承诺，再打开验证者查询的少数位置。数十年的工作推广并优化了这一范式，但其在标准模型中可证明的精确安全性仍不清楚。现有分析依赖回绕，并留下缺口：严格时间分析会损失一个逆多项式因子，而期望时间分析更尖锐，却只适用于该范式的特例。本文同时填补这两个缺口。负面结果证明严格时间损失是固有的：任何依赖黑盒抽取器的严格多项式时间归约都无法达到可忽略的知识误差（除非底层语言本身容易）。正面结果给出新的期望时间分析，在对抗期望多项式时间对手时，用期望多项式时间归约达到可忽略的可靠性与知识误差，并覆盖该范式的全部一般性，包括多轮与函数式变体，例如用相应承诺编译的多项式 IOP 与线性 IOP。这是标准模型中首次对实践部署的简洁论证达到这一制度的分析。
papers.abstractEn: Succinct arguments are central cryptographic objects, underlying various applications such as blockchains and image authentication. Almost all succinct arguments used in practice follow the commit-and-open paradigm introduced by Kilian (STOC 1992): commit to a probabilistic proof, then open the few locations the verifier queries. Decades of work have generalized and optimized this paradigm, yet its exact provable security in the standard model remains unclear. Existing analyses proceed by rewinding, and they leave gaps: strict-time analyses lose an inverse-polynomial factor, while expected-time analyses are sharper but apply only to special cases of this paradigm. We resolve both gaps. On the negative side, we show that the strict-time loss is inherent: no strict polynomial-time reduction relying on a black-box extractor can achieve negligible knowledge error (unless the underlying language is easy). On the positive side, we give a new expected-time analysis, achieving negligible soundness and knowledge errors via an expected polynomial-time reduction against expected polynomial-time adversaries, at the full generality of the paradigm, capturing multi-round and functional variants such as polynomial and linear IOPs compiled with the corresponding commitments. This is the first standard-model analysis to reach this regime for succinct arguments deployed in practice.
